analysis.headline: USD/KRW jumps 6.2 KRW to 1,336.2 on 5.2% KOSPI drop; DXY near 103.9
analysis.summary: USD/KRW rose 6.2 KRW to close at 1,336.2 in Seoul (ECB ref 1,339.44) as tech-led risk-off sent KOSPI down 5.21% to 4,869.96 with 1.7T KRW foreign outflows. Intraday highs hit 1,340.3 before exporter sales, while DXY held ~103.9 and 1M NDF hovered near 1,334.7.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW jumps to 1,472.0 as won slide outweighs EUR/USD near 1.097–1.099
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW rebounded sharply to around 1,472.0 (ECB ref 1,472.04). EUR/USD stayed pinned near 1.097–1.099 toward a third weekly drop on Fed-ECB divergence, though Seoul's 5.2% KOSPI plunge and foreign outflows drove USD/KRW up to 1,336.2, pulling the cross higher.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW surges to 844.3 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY retreats to 158.7–159.1
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW jumped to around 8.44 KRW per JPY (~844.3 per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.443). After failing to clear 160.0, USD/JPY fell ~0.5% to 158.7–159.1 on softer US yields and pre-weekend profit-taking, amplifying gains alongside Seoul's weaker won.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW rebounds over 10 KRW to 1,758.0 as won slump offsets soft cable
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW rose over 10 KRW to around 1,758.0 (ECB ref 1,757.97). Better UK Oct retail sales (+0.7% MoM) helped GBP/USD recover from 1.3079 to 1.310–1.311 despite a 3rd weekly dip, while Seoul's won drop to 1,336.2 drove the cross higher.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW reclaims 200.6 on won slide despite steady 6.7131 PBOC fix
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW climbed back above 200 to around 200.6 (ECB ref 200.58). While the PBOC set a steady USD/CNY midpoint at 6.7131, Seoul USD/KRW jumped 6.2 KRW to 1,336.2 amid a sharp local equity sell-off and broad risk-off flows, lifting the yuan-won cross.

AUD.headline: AUD edges up to 892.8 KRW as won slide offsets RBA pause bets and gold dip
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar edged up to 892.8 KRW as Seoul's won drop to 1,336.2 offset AUD/USD slipping to 0.663–0.666 on RBA pause bets.

CAD.headline: CAD rises to 936.2 KRW as won slump outweighs wide US-Canada yield spread
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar climbed to 936.2 KRW on won weakness even as wide yield spreads kept USD/CAD near 1.434 despite WTI up 0.93% at $83.98.

CHF.headline: CHF jumps to 1,596.1 KRW on equity haven demand and Seoul won drop
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc surged to 1,596.1 KRW as global equity sell-offs lifted CHF (EUR/CHF 0.9223) despite SNB caution alongside won weakness.

CNY.headline: CNY reclaims 200.6 KRW on Seoul won drop despite steady 6.7131 PBOC fix
CNY.brief: The yuan reclaimed 200.6 KRW after Seoul's 6.2 KRW jump in USD/KRW to 1,336.2 outweighed a steady 6.7131 PBOC midpoint fixing.

EUR.headline: EUR rebounds to 1,472.0 KRW on won slump despite EUR/USD near 1.097–1.099
EUR.brief: The euro jumped to 1,472.0 KRW as lower US yields and Seoul's won slump to 1,336.2 offset EUR/USD pressure near 1.097–1.099.

GBP.headline: GBP rallies to 1,758.0 KRW on UK retail sales beat and Seoul won slide
GBP.brief: Sterling jumped to 1,758.0 KRW after UK Oct retail sales (+0.7%) lifted GBP/USD to 1.310–1.311 while KRW weakened to 1,336.2.

HKD.headline: HKD rises to 170.9 KRW tracking Seoul USD/KRW's 6.2 KRW climb to 1,336.2
HKD.brief: Pegged near 7.839 per USD inside its 7.75–7.85 band, the Hong Kong dollar climbed to 170.9 KRW in lockstep with USD/KRW at 1,336.2.

JPY.headline: JPY surges to 844.3 per 100 JPY as USD/JPY dips to 158.7–159.1 & won falls
JPY.brief: The yen jumped to 844.3 KRW per 100 JPY as USD/JPY eased 0.5% to 158.7–159.1 after failing at 160 while Seoul's won dropped.

KRW.headline: KRW falls 6.2 KRW to 1,336.2 as KOSPI plunges 5.2% on 1.7T foreign sales
KRW.brief: The won dropped 6.2 KRW to 1,336.2 as KOSPI plunged 5.21% to 4,869.96 on tech selling and 1.7T KRW foreign outflows; NDF ~1,334.7.

USD.headline: USD jumps 6.2 KRW to 1,336.2 in Seoul on risk-off; DXY holds near 103.9
USD.brief: USD/KRW closed up 6.2 KRW at 1,336.2 in Seoul (ECB 1,339.44) as hawkish Fed bets and equity rout kept DXY near 103.9; NDF ~1,334.7.
